effects.name: operational-database-writes
effects.system: Portal Operational Store SQLite database file and its write-ahead log
effects.detail: Committed SQLite transactions, including migrations 2, 3, 4, and 5 on a new database, the Source Record index and selection writes, Processing Job, lease, attempt, outcome, Canonical Revision, and item-quarantine writes, policy, supersession, reprocessing-job, and re-queue-mark writes, and Processor Generation, summary-token, Summary Refresh Job, refresh lease and attempt, candidate summary revision, watermark, contributor-link, policy-link, and evidence-bookmark writes; a refused or failed operation commits nothing.
